existing_rule.meaning: Production requires supported rights verification. Unresolved material rights block; current skin-alpha coverage does not waive this. These are owner-maintained admission policies, not official Kodi screenshot requirements.

legal_effect: Changes only this unofficial repository admission requirement. It does not grant third-party redistribution rights, override font EULAs or other licenses, or establish that the proposed public distribution is authorized by the relevant rights holders. The documented SF Distant Galaxy and Nasalization restrictions and other unresolved findings remain adverse findings.
